q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
quote: An octopus has three hearts! Two pump blood to its gills, and one pumps it around its body.

q: Which imaginary animal is Scotland's national animal?
quote: It's the unicorn! Scotland has used this magical creature as a royal symbol for centuries.

q: Which planet has a day longer than its year?
quote: Venus takes 243 Earth days to spin once, but only 225 Earth days to travel around the Sun.

q: What body part can butterflies use to taste?
quote: Butterflies have taste sensors on their feet. They can taste a leaf just by standing on it!

q: What do some sea otters do while sleeping?
quote: Some sea otters hold paws while floating so they don't drift apart. That's a pretty cute bedtime trick!

q: Which animal has fingerprints surprisingly similar to ours?
quote: Koala fingerprints look remarkably like human fingerprints, even under a microscope!

q: Which food is actually a berry, according to scientists?
quote: Bananas are berries in botany! Strawberries aren't technically berries. Fruit names can be confusing.

q: About how long was the shortest recorded war?
quote: The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 lasted about 45 minutes. That's shorter than many family board games!
